comparisons.peer_topic: Significant Customer Revenue Concentration in Fiscal 2024
comparisons.peer_summary: In fiscal 2024, revenues from Apple, Samsung, and Xiaomi each comprised 10% or more of Qualcomm's consolidated revenues, continuing a historical trend where a small number of customers account for a significant portion of revenues.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and QCOM disclose that a small number of customers account for a significant portion of consolidated revenues, creating concentration risk. AVGO reports that its top five end customers accounted for approximately 40% of net revenue in fiscal 2024, whereas QCOM specifies that revenues from Apple, Samsung, and Xiaomi each comprised 10% or more of its consolidated revenues in fiscal 2024. Both companies highlight this structural reliance on a limited client base as a key business characteristic.

sentences.text: A relatively small number of customers account for a significant portion of our net revenue.
We believe aggregate sales to our top five end customers, through all channels, accounted for approximately 40% and 35% of our net revenue for fiscal years 2024 and 2023, respectively.
A small number of customers/licensees historically have accounted for a significant portion of our consolidated revenues.
In fiscal 2024, revenues from Apple, Samsung and Xiaomi each comprised 10% or more of our consolidated revenues.
